venue.name: Cafe Nona
venue.description: Cafe Nona is unique in that it never closes. Any day or time you find yourself craving for a schnitzel, this American-style eatery has you covered. Known amongst locals for its drink specials until 2 in the morning, it’s the spot to keep drinking while satiating your hunger pains. The laid back atmosphere means you'll never be rushed, giving you ample time to work your way through the large Israeli breakfast, which is served all day. The menu is filled with typical local fare, including sandwiches, salads and bourekas.

venue_raw.short_description: A Well Known Coffee House in Tel Aviv
